name: VEAF Mission Creation Tools
summary: VEAF's Lua mission framework plus a CLI that builds .miz files from version-controlled sources.
description: The runtime Lua modules are loaded inside missions (spawning via F10 markers, CAS/convoy/QRA missions, radio menus). The `veaf-tools` CLI extracts and rebuilds .miz files and injects weather, waypoints and presets.

releases.changelog: Open Training v6 release: Falklands support, WW2 units for CAS, Normandy/Sinai parking data, FARP/convoy/QRA changes.
